note: One entry per stock for its page on the desk: sector, valuation (with its source and date), the latest session's trading, dates coming up, the desk's views and news. The daily run updates it; news and views are kept, newest first, and never deleted.

next.why: Thursday's 100 bps hike widens lending margins; another move would matter as much.

views.note: High rates protect lending margins and T-bill income. CIB rose 0.5% on Thursday and is 17% up this year. Wrong if: CIB falls more than the EGX30 over the next two weeks.

news.text: CIB rose 0.5% to EGP 120.47 on the day the central bank raised rates by 100 basis points.
Commercial International Bank closed at its lowest since 31 March as the EGX30 fell 1.6%.

Signed an agreement with the state to develop four mixed-use projects in East Cairo, Alexandria and the North Coast, with targeted investment of about EGP 11 trillion over more than 37 million square metres. President El-Sisi also asked the government to work with the group on 200,000 homes for rent.
Unaudited nine-month profit rose to about EGP 12.97bn, roughly double a year earlier, helped by steadier gas supplies.

The board awarded the second phase of its solar plants, about 3 MW for EGP 76.2m over 12 months, to the Arab Organization for Industrialization, and approved a McKinsey-drafted strategy to start in fiscal 2027.
Al Ahly Pharos put Palm Hills' fair value at EGP 21.40 a share, about 74% above its price at the time (EGP 12.28), based on existing assets alone.
Third-quarter profit roughly doubled to $15.4bn from $7.5bn a year earlier, on revenue up about 33% to $113.2bn, beating estimates on higher oil prices and record output.
Lined up a $25bn bond sale to fund AI spending, its first bond sale since 2017.
UBS cut its price target to $332 from $380 and kept a neutral rating after search and YouTube revenue missed forecasts.
A $63bn financing deal tied to Anthropic gives Broadcom a funded customer for its AI chip forecast, according to 24/7 Wall St.; reported by one outlet so far.
